answer_1.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) are fundamentally transforming how enterprises operate, driving improvements in productivity across departments. These models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in automating knowledge-intensive tasks, from question answering and code generation to report writing and data analysis.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include plans for enterprise tasks, tool calls, CRUD operations, and natural language responses for notifications or reports.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate Compound AI systems on EnterpriseBench, we assess the correctness of the final execution of each task. For all tasks, correctness is determined using Prometheus-2 with GPT-4 and Gemini-2.5 Pro, as proposed by , which provides a rubric-based score ranging from 1 to 5.

answer_4.quote: In addition to automated evaluation, we conduct human evaluation focusing on two aspects: (a) whether the agent successfully completed the task, and (b) experts are required to complete the task. A separate set of experts then assess the correctness of these human-executed tasks. Scores are averaged across three experts serving as annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Experts were asked to assess whether the agent successfully completed the task and to complete the task themselves, after which another set of experts evaluated the correctness of the human-executed tasks.
